memorybank_faiss_en.reference: English SiliconFriend JSON+FAISS memory path with CLI retrieval configuration and native ChatGLM evaluation prompt, not the ChatGPT LlamaIndex branch

formation.schedule_status: benchmark adaptation of upstream user-triggered summarization

prompt.status: explicit benchmark context policy; CLI itself retains up to 7 history pairs

scope_notes: CLI DataArguments passes k=2; the retriever class fallback k=3 is not the CLI setting.
CHUNK_SIZE=200 counts characters for adjacent-document expansion, not tokens or a cap on the base hit.
The selected native prompt includes overall_personality and recent dialogue. overall_history content is not interpolated, although its presence affects the app gate.
Upstream summarization is user-triggered. One summarization after complete historical import is the explicit replay policy; native daily and overall functions are retained.
API backbone replacement retains memory prompts, storage and retrieval; it is not exact local ChatGLM/BELLE model inference.
Forgetting defaults to disabled. The locally patched forget_memory.py is not selected.
The deletion context uses the upstream evaluation prompt with empty recent history, not the CLI new-user fallback; this context policy is recorded, not a full chat-UI reproduction.
